dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a smooth falcate curve from the posterior peduncle junction to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The base width of the fin is approximately 1.1 times the vertical height from the dorsal midline to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white, v-shaped or avian-shaped pigment mark is visible on the flank below the anterior base of the fin. Minor linear abrasions are visible on the mid-lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp color transition from a dark gray/black dorsal fin to a lighter, reflective gray lateral surface with several small white punctate marks near the ventral boundary of the visible frame.
